summary: Validated BUG FIX for auto-dismiss of #pgmei-banner inside the PGMEI iframe. Executed Playwright scenarios: (1) empty CNPJ -> red err banner, (2) invalid CNPJ 11111111111111 -> red err banner, (3) valid CNPJ 11222333000181 -> green ok banner, (4) close button immediate dismiss. For all three show cases, banner appears with class 'show err/ok' right after click, has 'fade-out' at ~2.2s, and class is cleared (no 'show') by ~3.1s. Close button clears banner immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: showBanner cleanup uses nested setTimeout(800ms) after fade-out add; works fine but if user triggers another show during the 2s window the dismissTimer is cleared yet the second inner setTimeout from the previous cycle is not tracked. In current flow (user-driven) not a real issue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Banner auto-dismiss (2s + 0.8s fade) and close button verified via frame_locator on data-testid='pgmei-frame'. Selectors used: #continuar, #cnpj, #pgmei-banner, .pgmei-banner-close.
